scope: apps/web desktop interface, including CF-504 CTF pages

purple_ban.method: Search apps/web/src for violet, purple and the three banned hex values after replacing the Elite Hacker rank color

text_contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance for the main light/dark design tokens and reviewed lime text usages

touch_targets.method: Source review of shared Button minimum height and lab/learning/CTF submit controls
touch_targets.evidence: Button has min-h-11 (44px), including size sm; the CTF flag input now has min-h-11

keyboard_and_labels.method: Source review of skip link, creator attachment input and native checkbox labels
keyboard_and_labels.evidence: A skip link is present in the root layout; the file input has an accessible name; remaining checker flags are checkboxes wrapped in visible labels

static_scanners.accessibility_checker: 56 files, 3 reported issues; manually reviewed as false positives for labeled checkboxes

browser_smoke.method: Next.js production build served on localhost; checked /arena and /access/vpn in a desktop browser
browser_smoke.evidence: The skip link receives first Tab focus and Enter navigates to #main-content. The VPN heading renders rgb(72, 107, 22) on rgb(249, 249, 251).

fixes: Replaced violet Elite Hacker rank color with teal
Moved the skip link into the root layout so authentication routes also have it
Added an accessible name to the Creator Studio attachment input
Replaced low-contrast lime text on light backgrounds in CTF, VPN and Creator screens
Raised the CTF flag input to a 44px minimum height
limitations: Static source checks, selected color pairs and browser smoke do not certify every rendered state against all WCAG 2.1 AA criteria
The local API was not running during browser smoke, so authenticated CTF, Creator and lab states were not exercised
The generic UX script warnings are heuristic suggestions, not 405 confirmed defects
